verdict.rationale: Slack has first-party help articles for exporting workspace data and for its import/export tools, so a native export capability exists, but the pack shows only the article titles. A community report says Corporate Export of DMs and private channels requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval, which limits the 'all of my data' part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of which data is included in a standard export, documentation of open export formats (e.g. JSON), unrestricted export of DMs and private channels, and hands-on confirmation that a full migration out works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
